description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Collective Agreement No. 14 of 2015 entered into between Srilankan Catering Limited and Sri Lanka Nidahas Sevaka Sangamaya
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a collective agreement between a private company (SriLankan Catering Limited) and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, working conditions, and labor relations, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on establishing a legal framework for labor relations rather than government administration.
